'''Kamikikikatsu no Mikoto''' (神聞勝命) was an ancient Japanese noble and an ancestor of the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|en|Nakatomi clan|qid=Q1198447|lt=Nakatomi clan}}.

== Overview ==
Kamikikikatsu no Mikoto is mentioned in the *{{ill|Hitachi no Kuni Fudoki|ja|常陸国風土記}}* in the Kashima District section. According to the text, during the reign of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|en|Emperor Sujin|qid=Q333530|lt=Emperor Sujin}}, a deity appeared at the summit of {{ill|Futakami-yama|ja|二上山|lt=Mount Futakami (or Nijo)}}, wearing white divine robes and holding a white halberd. Upon receiving divine instructions, the emperor gathered eighty officials to inquire about the god who had descended. Kamikikikatsu no Mikoto identified the deity as {{ill|Takemikazuchi|en|Takemikazuchi|qid=Q1502690|qid=Q1502690|lt=Takemikazuchi}}, the celestial god enshrined in Kashima Province, declaring that the god's instructions were meant for governing the land of Ōyashima. Upon hearing this, the emperor, astonished and reverent, dedicated offerings to the shrine, including swords, halberds, bows, arrows, iron tools, horses, sa11les, mirrors, and fabrics in five colors.

== Genealogy ==
Kamikikikatsu no Mikoto was the son of {{ill|Nashitomi|ja|梨迹臣命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Nashitomi no Mikoto|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q108616765}} and {{ill|Tomikiya-hime no Mikoto|ja|冨炊屋媛命|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Tomikiya-hime no Mikoto|ja_comment=jawiki link invalid|qid=Q135579611}}.<ref>『{{ill|Sonpi Bunmyaku|en|Sonpi Bunmyaku|qid=Q1704738|lt=Sonpi Bunmyaku}}』</ref>
